name: Mantel
summary: A florist's flowers in bright, grand rooms: this week's arrangement edge to edge with no words on it, then a pale band in the colour taken from those flowers holding the name, the prices, the honest same-day line and one button. In the room and to your door side by side, the bouquet handed over in its wrap, rooms dressed one at a time. Stem-white ground, Hedvig Letters Serif and Sans, square fine controls; the only colour is the week's, so the site changes with the flowers. For florists who deliver by hand and dress rooms.
